title: Migrating to Next.js 15 & React 19: Architecture & Performance Lessons
description: A deep dive into migrating large-scale React applications to Next.js 15, detailing async router APIs, hydration fixes, and caching.
content: Next.js 15 introduces several breaking changes... Here is how we managed the transition, cleaned up configuration files, and resolved React 19 server component warnings.

title: Building Modular Frontend Architecture with Feature-Based Folders
description: How to organize massive React or Next.js codebases using modular design principles, making them scalable, decoupled, and easy to maintain.
content: Modular architecture allows developers to scale projects by splitting files based on business domains rather than tech layers...
